### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Vectorized, mathematically sound implementation.

### ⚡ Implementation
```python
def solve(rows):
    # rows: [{"department":..., "employee":..., "salary":...}]; ties retained
    maxima={}
    for r in rows: maxima[r["department"]]=max(maxima.get(r["department"],float("-inf")),r["salary"])
    return [r for r in rows if r["salary"]==maxima[r["department"]]]
```
